description: This file provides Mongolian language localization strings for the Summernote WYSIWYG editor. It extends the Summernote language object with translations for menu options, tooltips, and other UI elements specific to the 'mn-MN' locale.

methods.name: $.extend
methods.description: A jQuery method used to merge the contents of two or more objects into the first object. In this context, used to extend the Summernote language object with Mongolian translations.
